function notifToJSON(notif) { return {
            "notificationId": notif.notificationId,
            "actions": notif.actions,
            "appIcon": notif.appIcon,
            "appName": notif.appName,
            "body": notif.body,
            "image": notif.image,
            "summary": notif.summary,
            "time": notif.time,
            "urgency": notif.urgency,
        } }
